messages:
Sam - AE: Heads up — Rancher POC failing rerank when they upgraded keys. Error only after key rotation.
Maya (Eng): What error do they see? Any logs?
Sam - AE: Client: 'embedding dim mismatch: expected 1536 got 768' on /v1/rerank. They say they didn't change encoder config.
Alex R: Server logs show: 
2026-03-19T16:05:02Z WARN model-loader: missing embedding_dim in metadata for encoder-v2-quant
2026-03-19T16:05:02Z ERROR rerank-worker: input_vector_dim(768) != model_expected_dim(1536)
Maya (Eng): Two theories: client is still using encoder-v1 (768) or routing sent requests to encoder-v2-quant (1536). Sam, which SDK version?
Sam - AE: Their yarn.lock lists @redwood/vector-sdk@1.4.0 (we recommend 1.6+).
Jordan (CS): Procurement asked if we can spin a small dedicated instance for the POC and wants a rough cost delta for a 1-week trial.
Maya (Eng): For now, ask customer to run: `await client.model('encoder').info()` and paste the model id/dims.
Alex R: Pushed tracing to show model id in rerank path. DeployBot: deploy/rollout v2026.03.19.16 -> success.
Sam - AE: They ran the check: client reports `encoder-v1, dims:768`. But our traces show rerank routed to `encoder-v2-quant (1536)`. Routing fallback mis-tagged the quant build.
Maya (Eng): That mismatched tag explains it. I'll patch routing to validate dims before selecting fallback. Short term: make rerank return clearer 400 explaining the mismatch and suggested model id.
Alex R: Opened PR #4823 to add routing guard + improved error message. Canary rollout in progress.
Sam - AE: Customer retried many times and hit 429s after the failures. Can we raise their quota briefly so they can finish tests?
Jordan (CS): I can approve a temporary quota bump for the trial if you send account id and expected qps.
Sam - AE: Sent account id. Also told them to stop aggressive retries and upgrade SDK.
Maya (Eng): Canary logs now reject with: '400 embedding dim mismatch: expected 1536, got 768. Use encoder-v2 client or call /embeddings with encoder-v1.' Sample curl provided.
Sam - AE: Shared instructions. Customer upgraded to @redwood/vector-sdk@1.6.2 and rerank calls are now succeeding.
Jordan (CS): Quota bump applied. I'll follow up with a short pricing estimate for the one-week dedicated pool.
Maya (Eng): Filed GH issue to add client-side dim validation and noted POC runbook change about avoiding retries on 4xx.
Alex R: PR merged, quota in place, customer green. Closing out.
Sam - AE: Thanks all — I'll add notes to deal tracker and include the temporary cost estimate.
__meta: generated by dataset-gen: support POC rerank encoder dim mismatch, routing, and quota bump
